decision: Admit exactly one elbow-only sample-domain task challenger over the four immutable V5 action tensors and five already frozen reset variants. Preserve requested action bytes, direct targets on all non-elbow joints, 40 Hz row order, the canonical evaluator, the prior direct/ZOH 40/40 baseline, and false hardware and mapping authority. Report every applied row outside the measured physical support as extrapolative. A 20/20 challenger pass may open a separately frozen no-contact mapping-resolution extension; any task failure closes V5 without hardware.
